statement: Every n-vertex graph in the recursively defined QS subclass has complex planar realization count 2^(n−2), retaining reflected realizations.

source.location: Section 9, definition of QS and Theorem 9.1, printed p.32; Section 2, congruence convention

scope: QS starts with K3 and is closed under gluing G1 to G2−uv along any two distinct vertices of G1 and the endpoints of an edge uv of G2, for G1,G2 in QS. n≥3; generic edge lengths.
notes: The source identifies reflections and counts 2^(n−3); generic noncollinearity doubles this under the catalogue convention.
